summary: Patriarch's daughter Sophia Berger appointed to family-trust investment committee. Wants to introduce impact-investing sleeve at next IPS review.
Family asked for a CHF 1.5m subscription to be deployed before the May review meeting (received 2026-04-18, see txn-002).
New foundation board chair Dr. Helena Brand starts 2026-06-01. Has flagged interest in tightening fossil-fuel exclusion list.
Foundation completed FINMA Circular 2024/2 sustainability questionnaire; CPI compliance has filed on the foundation's behalf.
Family principal Henri Lindemann attended Davos sustainability roundtable; has asked for an in-depth view on European infrastructure exposure ahead of the May 22 review.
PE sleeve has drifted to 28% (IPS target 25%, hard band 25% before flag). Investment committee notified; rebalance discussion scheduled for May review.
Daughter (age 19) starting Master's at ETH Zurich in autumn 2026. Family wants an education-funding sub-account discussion.

Legacy Müller Holding AG stake (XX0000000015) is at ~15% of AUM, exceeding IPS max-single-position of 10%. Excluded from rebalancing per IPS notes (lock-up until 2027-09-30); flag persists in monitoring.
Trustee chair received FINMA Circular 2024/2 sustainability disclosure templates; CPI is preparing the trustee-facing summary for the June 30 review.
